# Handoff Acknowledged

## Status Summary

| Metric | Champion (v5) | Last PASS Candidate |
|--------|---------------|---------------------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.31%** | -11.18% |

## Assessment

**Champion v5 holds.** The last candidate (`exp_macro_alpha_shadow`) passed validation but didn't dethrone:
- Lower tuning performance (1.76 vs 1.90)
- Worse drawdown (-11.18% vs -9.31%)
- Only advantage: better lockbox minimum (1.35 vs 1.13)

## Runloop Health
- ✅ 299 iterations completed
- ✅ ~16 hours remaining
- ✅ No stuck INCONCLUSIVE candidates
- ✅ Stable champion through extended testing

## Ready to Continue

```bash
# Execute next commands as specified:
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

Proceeding with automated exploration. Will flag if:
- New candidate beats champion
- MDD exceeds -12% threshold
- Tuning min drops below 0.0 (instability signal)
